method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading and reverse paraphrase of all changed prose and the footnote; exact math, macro, label and reference parity. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Finite-alphabet, simultaneous-action, stay-put, tape geometry and multiplicity variants; nondeterministic transition relations; halting and end-marker conventions; unary/binary number coding; invariance of computable functions and an interleaving simulation sketch.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The given machine model permits arbitrary finite alphabets, simultaneous write-and-move and stationary writes, but restricts tape direction and uses one tape and a transition function. Other definitions may use only stroke and blank, separate writing from movement, omit stay, permit a two-way tape, multiple tapes, an infinite square grid or a transition relation.
samples.checks: All liberal-versus-restrictive contrasts and the two named symbols are preserved without claiming a unique canonical machine definition.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A functional delta fixes a unique new symbol, state and direction for a current state-symbol pair. A transition relation may contain two distinct successor triples for one pair, yielding a nondeterministic machine important in computational complexity.
samples.checks: Both displayed five-tuples, current pair, successor triple and non-unique relation reading are unchanged. अनिर्धारक is explained as multiple possible next moves, not an undefined delta.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A machine may halt on undefined delta or by entering a designated state; the previous section says the latter does not change computational power. A left move at square zero may stay put or halt. Deleting end-marker left transitions is only a first approximation because the marker may occur elsewhere; the source footnote proposes a second marker. Numbers may use unary or binary code, with binary needing two further symbols beyond blank and marker.
samples.checks: The left-edge transition tuple, square-zero index, end-marker-prime symbol, cross-reference and unary/binary symbol count are preserved. The footnote's explicit limitation corroborates the separately recorded OLTUR-006 caveat.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: All these variants compute the same class of Turing-computable functions. A one-way single tape can simulate a two-way or multiple-tape machine by using extra states and instructions; the sketch interleaves even squares for the first tape or positive side and odd squares for the second tape or negative side.
samples.checks: The two-way equivalence claim, proof-deferral caveat and even/odd assignments are retained as a sketch rather than promoted to a full construction.

source_observations: T344 labels transition-relation nondeterminism as अनिर्धारक and keeps it distinct from the chapter's undefined-transition halting condition.
The frozen footnote explicitly notes that the tape-end marker can occur away from square zero, supporting the OLTUR-006 reader note in the preceding section.
